item.summary: JXK Enterprises, Inc is voluntarily recalling Boner Bears Chocolate, Lot #BB21125, after being notified that FDA laboratory analysis confirmed the presence of sildenafil, an active ingredient in the FDA-approved prescription drug Viagra, which is not declared on the product label. Product details: Boner Bears CHOCOLATE, 3 DOSES PER BAR, NET WT. 22g, MALE ENHANCEMENT, DOSAGE: Consume 1 piece at least 1 hour prior to activity. Do not exceed 1 piece in any 48 hour period. Serving size about 7 g
item.affectedPeople: Boner Bears Chocolate is marketed as a sexual enhancement product and was distributed nationwide via online sales through www.elyxr.com.
item.payoutAmount: Refund, replacement, correction, or disposal if stated by the official notice
